rationale: Builds on the current staged reverse-tail best with a compact recurrence-scheduling edit. The repeated tail block replay still follows the proven staged gain, while the learned carry toward the decoder-output anchor now uses sqrt(gain), giving anchor correction more training signal before full recurrence is active. Final evaluation uses gain 1, so the exact int8+zlib scoring path, artifact budget, validation split, and print markers stay unchanged.
title: Sqrt-Lead Reverse-Tail Carry Curriculum
